## Contract version read
`semkg_contract.py` reports `CONTRACT_VERSION = 2`, so the v2 behavior — a plain `float(value)` cast — is what I copied. `producer.py` contains no `import semkg_contract` and no runtime reference to it; the semantics and the assumed version (2) are preserved locally via the inlined `CONTRACT_VERSION = 2` and the docstring record of the source.

## Local check
Ran an isolated check by `exec`-ing the file in a separate namespace (sandbox suppresses stdout, so validation was assertion-based, exit code 0):
- `normalize_price(1234) == 1234.0` and the result is `float` ✅
- `normalize_price('3.5') == 3.5` (same `float()` coercion path) ✅
- `'semkg_contract' not in sys.modules` after loading — confirms no contract import occurred ✅
